title: Geologic map of the Limehouse and Port Wentworth quadrangles, Beaufort and Jasper counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2008, Geologic map of the Limehouse and Port Wentworth quadrangles, Beaufort and Jasper counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-151, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Two sheets: Limehouse (page 1) and Port Wentworth (page 2, mostly Georgia; only me and QHfw described, no holes recorded). Map symbols read on the Limehouse map face and section images (OCR garbled 'aHfw', 'Ppt', '[Pir', 'NMa_'). OCR 'Thickness | to 40' read as 1 (inferred, unclear). 26 SCGS drill-hole labels read on the map face; no logs printed. Section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 100) read for unit labels; contacts not digitized. SUBSURFACE: Princess Anne terrace sediments above 12 ft and below 18 ft; Pamlico above 17 ft and below 25 ft; Jasper sediments between 10 and 20 ft (no datum printed); section contacts not digitized.
